Contact

Found an app or website that slips through, an AI companion or chatbot we missed, or something blocked that should not be? Tell us here. Adding an app to the policy is easy, and it reaches every phone at its next check.

Your message is emailed to the people behind drawbridge and goes nowhere else. The check against bots is Cloudflare Turnstile, from the company that already hosts this site.
